svg.aria-label: Aegis Ultimate: Private search engine and Chromium browser. Zero-logging search that runs entirely in RAM, with in-memory BM25 ranking, an autonomous crawler and an LLM answer layer that cites its sources. Query time: under 5 ms. Tests: 87 of 87 passing. Built with: JavaScript, Node.js, Express.
